answer: Continuous work provenance: each identity earns standing only through verified task completions that emit a signed ripple into a shared ledger, and rewards unlock in slow tranches tied to that history. Any pulse of new accounts starts at zero standing, so cloned identities must independently redo the full work trail to bid. A comet of fake signups therefore costs the attacker real completion labor per clone plus forfeited tranche value on any account caught sharing provenance, making honest single-account work cheaper.
